"Does it walk on four legs?" is yes for frog and turtle, no for snake. "Does it move by hopping?" is yes for frog only. "Is it a reptile?" is yes for snake and turtle.

Asking "Does it move by hopping?" first leaves frog (done) or {snake, turtle}, which still needs another question or guess. Guessing directly is about as efficient, so I'll guess.
